summary.en: Your suitcase did not arrive. Report it at the help desk, give the right information and agree on a solution.
summary.vi: Vali của bạn không đến. Hãy báo tại quầy hỗ trợ, cung cấp đúng thông tin và thống nhất cách giải quyết.

briefing.en: You have just arrived at an international airport in London after a long flight from Ho Chi Minh City. You waited at baggage claim, but your suitcase never came out. Go to the baggage help desk, explain the problem and give the information on your card exactly. Be ready for unexpected news and make sure you know how and when you will get your bag back.
briefing.vi: Bạn vừa đến một sân bay quốc tế ở London sau chuyến bay dài từ TP. Hồ Chí Minh. Bạn đã chờ ở băng chuyền hành lý nhưng vali của bạn không xuất hiện. Hãy đến quầy hỗ trợ hành lý, giải thích vấn đề và cung cấp chính xác thông tin trên thẻ của bạn. Hãy sẵn sàng cho tin bất ngờ và đảm bảo bạn biết khi nào và bằng cách nào mình sẽ nhận lại vali.

goals.en: Explain that your luggage is missing and ask for help
goals.vi: Giải thích rằng hành lý bị thất lạc và nhờ giúp đỡ

goals.en: Give your flight, arrival time, bag description, tag number and contact details
goals.vi: Cung cấp số hiệu chuyến bay, giờ đến, mô tả vali, số thẻ hành lý và thông tin liên lạc

goals.en: Ask follow-up questions and request a solution
goals.vi: Đặt câu hỏi thêm và yêu cầu hướng giải quyết

goals.en: Give a delivery address and confirm the solution
goals.vi: Cung cấp địa chỉ giao hàng và xác nhận cách giải quyết

goals.en: Ask when the bag will arrive and close politely
goals.vi: Hỏi khi nào vali đến và kết thúc lịch sự

studentCard.label: Flight
studentCard.value: Silverwing Air SW 215 from Ho Chi Minh City to London

studentCard.label: Bag description
studentCard.value: Large dark blue suitcase, hard shell, red ribbon on the handle

studentCard.label: Address in London
studentCard.value: Riverside Student Residence, 25 Elmwood Road, London

npc.name: Daniel Hughes
npc.personality: Calm, polite and helpful. He uses simple sentences, asks one question at a time and apologises for the problem.
npc.openingLine: Hello, this is the baggage help desk. How can I help you?
npc.closingLine: You're welcome. Sorry again for the trouble, and enjoy your stay in London.

npcFacts: The student's bag (tag SW 482913) was loaded by mistake onto flight SW 560 to Bangkok instead of SW 215 to London.
The bag is now safe at Bangkok airport.
The bag will be sent back on flight SW 561 tonight and will land in London at 7:15 am tomorrow.
The airline will deliver the bag to the student's address free of charge by 2 pm tomorrow.
The courier will send a text message one hour before delivery.
The file reference number for this case is WP-7734.
The student can buy essential items up to 50 pounds and keep the receipts to get the money back.

stages.title: Asking for Help
stages.npcGoal: Greet the student and ask what the problem is. Listen to the explanation, show sympathy and say you will help.
stages.fallbackLine: Hello, how can I help you? Is there a problem with your luggage?

objectives.description: Student explains that their luggage/suitcase did not arrive or is missing at baggage claim.
Student politely asks the agent for help to find the bag.

hints: Try: 'Excuse me, my suitcase didn't arrive.'
Try: 'I waited at baggage claim, but my bag is missing.'
sampleStudentLines: Excuse me, my luggage didn't arrive. I waited at the belt for an hour, but my suitcase is missing.
Could you help me find it, please?

stages.title: Providing Information
stages.npcGoal: Ask, one question at a time, for the flight number, arrival time, a description of the bag, the baggage tag number and contact details (phone or email). Repeat important details back to check them, and ask again if anything is unclear or does not match.
stages.fallbackLine: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me make a report. What was your flight number, and what time did you arrive?

objectives.description: Student gives the flight number SW 215 (from Ho Chi Minh City) exactly as on the card.
Student gives the arrival time 6:40 am.
Student describes the bag with details from the card: large, dark blue, hard shell, red ribbon on the handle.
Student gives the baggage tag number SW 482913 exactly.
Student gives contact details: phone number +44 7700 900123 and/or email minhanh.nguyen@student-mail.edu.

hints: Try: 'My flight number is SW 215 from Ho Chi Minh City.'
Try: 'It's a large dark blue suitcase with a red ribbon on the handle.'
Read numbers slowly, one digit at a time.
sampleStudentLines: My flight number is SW 215 from Ho Chi Minh City, and we landed at 6:40 this morning.
It's a large dark blue suitcase with a hard shell and a red ribbon on the handle.
The baggage tag number is SW 482913.
My phone number is +44 7700 900123, and my email is minhanh.nguyen@student-mail.edu.

stages.title: Unexpected Situation
stages.npcGoal: Explain the news about the bag in simple words. Answer the student's follow-up questions using only the facts, wait for the student to ask what can be done, then offer free delivery and ask for a delivery address.
stages.twist: After checking the computer, tell the student that their bag was put on the wrong flight by mistake: it went on flight SW 560 to Bangkok. Say the bag is safe. Do not offer a solution until the student asks a follow-up question or asks what can be done.
stages.fallbackLine: I've checked the system. I'm very sorry, but your bag was put on the wrong flight by mistake. It went to Bangkok.

objectives.description: Student asks a follow-up question about the situation, e.g. why it happened, where the bag is now, whether it is safe, or which flight it is on.
Student asks what the airline can do or requests a solution, such as sending or delivering the bag to them.
Student gives the delivery address: Riverside Student Residence, 25 Elmwood Road, London.

hints: Try: 'Why did that happen? Where is my bag now?'
Try: 'What can you do to solve this problem?'
Try: 'Could you deliver it to my address?'
sampleStudentLines: Oh no, why did that happen? Is my bag safe in Bangkok now?
What can you do to solve this problem? Could you send it to me?
Please deliver it to Riverside Student Residence, 25 Elmwood Road, London.

stages.title: Completing the Mission
stages.npcGoal: Summarise the solution (free delivery by 2 pm tomorrow, text message one hour before) and give the reference number. Let the student confirm, answer when the bag will arrive, and say goodbye politely.
stages.fallbackLine: So, we will deliver your bag to your address free of charge. Is that okay for you?

objectives.description: Student confirms or repeats the agreed solution (free delivery of the bag to their address).
Student asks when the bag will arrive or be delivered.
Student thanks the agent and ends the conversation politely.

hints: Try: 'So you will deliver my bag for free. Is that right?'
Try: 'Thank you for your help. Goodbye.'
sampleStudentLines: So you will bring my bag to my residence free of charge. Let me confirm that.
When will it arrive at my residence?
Thank you for your help. Have a good day!
